name: fast-overview
description: While Claude works on a conversational question, shows a fast overview card from a fast inference provider (Cerebras, Groq or OpenRouter)

openrouter_api_key.title: OpenRouter API key
openrouter_api_key.description: One key for everything: the overview model and every classifier. Enough on its own.

cerebras_api_key.title: Cerebras API key
cerebras_api_key.description: Optional. Calls Cerebras directly, about 50 ms faster than through OpenRouter.

groq_api_key.title: Groq API key
groq_api_key.description: Optional. Calls Groq directly for overview cards.

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafe_api_key.description: Optional. Calls the Jev classifier directly, about 100 ms faster than through OpenRouter.

liquid_api_key.title: Liquid AI API key
liquid_api_key.description: Optional. Calls the d1 classifier directly.

openai_api_key.title: OpenAI API key
openai_api_key.description: Optional. Calls the GPT-6 Luna Decisions classifier directly.

mode.title: When to show an overview
mode.description: auto: a classifier decides, only for questions you'll read a long answer to. always: every prompt. off: never.

overview_provider.title: Overview provider
overview_provider.description: Who writes the card. auto: the fastest one you have a key for (Cerebras, then Groq, then OpenRouter).

overview_model.title: Overview model
overview_model.description: Leave empty for Qwen3.8-27B, or name a model your provider serves.

classifier.title: Classifier
classifier.description: Decides which prompts get a card. auto: Jev, then d1, then the overview model itself. Each runs directly with its own key, else through OpenRouter.

share_project.title: Share project context
share_project.description: Send the repository's file map and the opening of README, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and manifests to the providers, so cards about your code are accurate.

log.title: Logging
log.description: off: nothing is written and cards offer no rating. ratings: your helpful / not helpful ratings with the classifier's verdict and timings, no text. full: also prompts, cards and Claude's answers. Logs go to ~/.local/state/fast-overview.
